validate.summary: All 21 missions valid; three-layer separation holds; evals valid.

threads.title: Unknown provenance disables enforcement
threads.reason: An unknown --provenance can only decline soundness, never claim it; unsetting ORCA_PROVENANCE gives the worker the identical advisory lane, and verify-gate.sh's pre-existing case already treats every non-listed value as advisory. The downgrade is recorded as an advisory NOTE in the verdict. Residual = operator-typo ergonomics (choices=), a follow-up nit outside the frozen spec.

threads.title: Writable binaries classified trusted
threads.reason: Premise false on the build host (/usr/local/bin is drwxr-xr-x root). The SYSTEM_BINS carve-out is the frozen spec's explicit F-1(b) design ('not a standard system bin dir'); resolving Homebrew's user-owned gh symlink would fail every sound lane closed on every Homebrew host. A worker able to write system bin dirs owns the toolchain running verify.py — outside the h409 threat model.
